Q43.question: BNS Section 64 aur BNSS Section 64 kya ek hi provision hain? Dono ko unke apne verified source se compare karo; sirf section number same hone par Act ka naam change mat karna.

response.answer:
Nahi, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) aur Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 64 bilkul alag provisions hain. Inka sirf number same hai, lekin inka maqsad aur content poori tarah se alag hai:

*   **Section 64 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS):** Yeh provision 'rape' ke apradh aur uski saza (punishment) se sambandhit hai. Isme rape ki paribhasha aur uske liye kam se kam 10 saal ki saza ya umra-kaid ka pravdhan diya gaya hai.
*   **Section 64 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS):** Yeh section rape jaise gambhir apradhon ke mamlon mein Magistrate dwara victim ka bayan (statement) record karne ki prakriya (procedure) ke baare mein hai. Isme bataya gaya hai ki kaise aur kin sharton ke saath Magistrate ko victim ka bayan darj karna chahiye.

Seedhe shabdon mein, BNS ka Section 64 yeh batata hai ki 'rape kya hai aur uski saza kya hogi', jabki BNSS ka Section 64 yeh batata hai ki 'us mamle mein bayan kaise record kiya jayega'. In dono ka aapas mein koi sambandh nahi hai, bas dono ka section number 64 hai.

Input Tax Credit (ITC) ke rules ke baare mein jaankari ke liye, main aapko bata doon ki mere paas jo documents hain, unki jankari 31 August 2021 tak hi updated hai. Isliye, yeh rules us samay tak ke legal framework par aadharit hain.

Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 ke Section 16 ke mutabiq, ITC lene ke liye kuch zaroori shartein hain:

*   **Business use:** Aap jo bhi goods ya services khareed rahe hain, woh aapke business ke dauran ya usko badhane ke liye istemal honi chahiye.
*   **Documents:** Aapke paas supplier dwara issue kiya gaya valid tax invoice ya debit note hona chahiye.
*   **Receipt:** Aapko goods ya services mil chuki honi chahiye.
*   **Payment:** Supplier ko tax ka bhugtan sarkar ko mil chuka hona chahiye (cash mein ya ITC use karke).
*   **Returns:** Aapne apna return file kiya hona chahiye.

Ek zaroori baat yeh hai ki agar aapne capital goods par depreciation claim kiya hai, toh aap us tax component par ITC nahi le sakte. Saath hi, agar aap supplier ko invoice ki date se 180 din ke andar payment nahi karte, toh aapko woh ITC interest ke saath wapas karna padta hai.

ITC claim karne ki ek time limit bhi hoti hai—financial year khatam hone ke baad 30 November tak, ya phir annual return file karne tak, jo bhi pehle ho. Agar goods lots ya instalments mein aate hain, toh aapko credit tabhi milta hai jab aapko aakhri lot mil jaata hai.
